description.html: A floor of 100x40 cm is the lower limit for an adult bearded dragon, and this model meets it: 4000 cm² of floor and about 160 liters of volume. The back is covered by a 3D background of hand-carved styrofoam, shaped like rock, which gives the dragon relief it can climb to get closer to the lamp.

Over a meter of length, the warm zone is set up at one end, with a spot lamp above a rock or branch, while the hide goes at the opposite, cooler end. The 40 cm height leaves room for a lamp and a low branch, but this is a terrarium for ground-dwelling animals. For a ball python or a kingsnake the same length allows them to stretch out along the back wall.

A variant without the 3D background exists as a separate model of the same dimensions, and the 100x45x45 and 100x50x50 have a wider floor. You choose the pattern of the outer film from the 34 on offer. If you need a different length or height, we build it to order in 7 to 14 days. We assemble the terrarium by hand in Novi Sad and ship it by courier, with the background already installed.
